import numpy as np

def information_bottleneck(p_y_given_x, p_x, beta, max_iter=100, tol=1e-6):
    n_x, n_y = p_y_given_x.shape
    n_t = min(n_x, n_y)
    
    p_t_given_x = np.random.dirichlet(np.ones(n_t), size=n_x)
    
    for iteration in range(max_iter):
        p_t = np.sum(p_t_given_x * p_x[:, np.newaxis], axis=0)
        
        p_joint_xt = p_t_given_x * p_x[:, np.newaxis]
        p_y_given_t = (p_joint_xt.T @ p_y_given_x) / p_t[:, np.newaxis]
        p_y_given_t = np.nan_to_num(p_y_given_t)
        
        p_t_given_x_new = np.zeros_like(p_t_given_x)
        for x in range(n_x):
            for t in range(n_t):
                kl_div = np.sum(p_y_given_x[x] * np.log(np.maximum(p_y_given_x[x], 1e-15) / np.maximum(p_y_given_t[t], 1e-15)))
                p_t_given_x_new[x, t] = p_t[t] * np.exp(-beta * kl_div)
            p_t_given_x_new[x] /= np.sum(p_t_given_x_new[x])
        
        if np.max(np.abs(p_t_given_x_new - p_t_given_x)) < tol:
            break
        p_t_given_x = p_t_given_x_new
    
    p_joint_xt = p_t_given_x * p_x[:, np.newaxis]
    i_xt = compute_mutual_information(p_joint_xt)
    
    p_joint_ty = p_t[:, np.newaxis] * p_y_given_t
    i_ty = compute_mutual_information(p_joint_ty)
    
    return p_t_given_x, i_xt, i_ty

def compute_mutual_information(p_joint):
    p_x = p_joint.sum(axis=1)
    p_y = p_joint.sum(axis=0)
    mask = p_joint > 0
    mi = np.sum(p_joint[mask] * np.log2(p_joint[mask] / (p_x[:, np.newaxis] * p_y)[mask]))
    return mi

np.random.seed(42)
p_x = np.array([0.3, 0.3, 0.2, 0.2])
p_y_given_x = np.array([
    [0.8, 0.2],
    [0.7, 0.3],
    [0.3, 0.7],
    [0.2, 0.8]
])

p_t_given_x, i_xt, i_ty = information_bottleneck(p_y_given_x, p_x, beta=1.0)
print(f"I(X;T) = {i_xt:.4f} bits")
print(f"I(T;Y) = {i_ty:.4f} bits")
